title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
abstract: arXiv:2608.11676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query

translated_title: XBridge：面向异构大语言模型通信的实体锚定潜在桥接
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11676v1 公告类型：新 摘要：异构多智能体大语言模型系统，其中智能体由不同模型家族驱动，通过减少冗余推理模式，可以优于同构配置。然而，现有通信协议要么通过文本操作，丢弃发送方的内部表示，要么需要架构同质性以实现潜在层面传输。我们识别了跨架构通信中的实体锚定问题：在不同大语言模型家族之间传输连续表示的交叉注意力桥接，会遭遇稀有令牌压缩崩溃，即实体身份在连续瓶颈中丢失（仅桥接的F1分数约30%）。我们提出XBRIDGE，一种免解码通信协议，通过两种机制解决此问题。词汇锚定映射（LAM）将发送方的原始上下文令牌映射到接收方的词汇表，提供离散实体锚点。潜在富化桥接（LEB）使接收方能够查询
tldr: XBRIDGE通过词汇锚定映射和潜在富化桥接机制，解决了异构大语言模型通信中跨架构实体锚定丢失的问题，实现了免解码的高效通信。
en_tdlr: XBRIDGE addresses the entity grounding problem in heterogeneous LLM communication via Lexical Anchor Mapping and Latent Enrichment Bridge, enabling decode-free efficient transfer.
